notes.title: Bakery Simulator delivery patch!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Bakers,[/h1]

[h3]We have not forgotten about you![/h3]
We are sorry you had to wait a long time for this update, we understand your bitterness. 
Like always we wanted to make sure that patch does not bring new issues, so we had to test it thoroughly. Therefore, now we are proud to present you the latest update to our game! 
We hope you will like our new delivery system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/dfcfe5c5866738448cc34f8382f6cb915fd905fc.png[/img]

[b]Before you start playing the newest version of the game[/b], we highly recommend resetting your profiles for maximum benefits from the patch, due to the game's save system structure. Otherwise, we do not guarantee the correct running of the game, due to interference in the game system. 
[b]Warning! After resetting your profile, you will lose all progress and have to start over.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/ee4df04746cd4c4a80b8497bfb8a4084f8fa4e60.gif[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.3.4[/h1]

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Change in the tutorial: improved steps requiring the use of PLUCK and TRASH CAN, changed the amount of recognized bad ingredient in the bowl to 1g from 5g. 
- Change in mechanics: Courier. Courier available from the completion of the tutorial. Swapping the courier unlocking perk for a discount for deliveries. Basic courier costs change from 10% of the cost of the order to 5%. The first upgrade - 3% of the cost of the order. The second upgrade - 2% of the cost of the order. 
- Change in mechanics: time for deliveries. Expanding the delivery times x2 to avoid time pressure.
- Changed the amount of money when starting the game from 5000 to 1000.
- Change in the driving mechanics, new driving system has been implemented for both small car and truck, changing the driving aspect into more arcade-like. 
- Changed the camera angle in the City to top view. It is possible to adjust the field of view by scrolling the scroll of the mouse up or down. 
- Changed delivery points markers to make the more visible.
- Muffins: small and large forms can be thrown from the tray straight into the trash can. 
- Change in mechanics: muffins. Added LMB hold option to streamline the addition of muffin papers to trays and pouring mass in one fell swoop.
- Machine improvements: Improved Rounder Divider performance.
Save system: Removed crashes that could cause progress to be removed. 

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed bigger performance issues on the City level, the level should run smoothly on the recommended setup even with graphic settings set to „very high”.
- Fixed issues with FPS loss, providing more stability on all tiers of bakery and City level. 
- Fixed texture and lighting issues in certain districts of the City level. 
- Fixed game crashes on deliveries. 
- Fix for loss of input on USB devices.
- Fix: The trigger on the red tray in the rounder divider is too small.
- Fix: The bowl from the large mixer does not respond to the reset of the position.
- Fix: After the reset of the position, the largest bowl on the cart does not detach from the player. Also added resetting the position to the default.
- Fix: Fixed problem with disappearing slots on tables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/8dd191ab45b17881e4d4018659b527fb992ac17c.png[/img]

Those who have already bought Bakery Simulator also get something - [b]great discounts on Gaming Factory games up to 90% - [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/gamingfactory/#browse

Thank you for playing Bakery Simulator!

notes.title: Bakery Simulator delivery patch incoming!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Bakers,[/h1]

We are still working on a final patch that will introduce a new delivery system and fixes. We know that you are all waiting for this, we want to make sure everything works perfectly. We plan to release this patch at the end of this month. At the moment, we are fixing the codes to make sure that all saves will works properly, but of course we will recommend that you start the game from scratch so that you can enjoy it to the fullest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/737f3ad385d4897fa9bd4df9794f2edf0e4acaed.png[/img]

We've received a lot of feedback about the delivery system, unfortunately most of you didn't enjoy it. That's why we decided to change it, we are aware that it's Bakery Simulator, not a delivery simulator but there was no point to delete the ready content from the game. Below, we would like to present you a little sneak peak of the upcoming update, we hope that you enjoy it! Of course, in addition to the new driving system, there will be bug fixes and improved optimization.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5pxZg9d.gif[/img]
[b]We've implemented a new driving system for both the small car and truck, changed the driving aspect into a arcade-like minigame! To avoid the time pressure, we will have doubled the delivery time.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HgrVQMz.gif[/img]
[b]The camera view will be changed to isometric view. Additionally, it will be possible to adjust the field of view by scrolling the scroll of the mouse up or down. The delivery points markers will be more visible.
[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uxrCblx.gif[/img]
[b]The delivery car now has better driving feeling, so this minigame will be more enjoyable to the players who will want to do the deliveries, the curier persk stays in place, so some of you will be able to skip the delivery.[/b]

[i]Thank you for playing Bakery Simulator!
Gaming Factory team.[/i]

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #96 “Helpful tips to the rescue!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]In the hustle of a daily Baker's life it's easy to get lost from time to time. Here is the way to always get back on your feet![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/7e4a9144e6b5d4e7879123f9b2d3089de0283842.png[/img]

Let's imagine that you've just received your new machine and you are so excited to finally try it. Sadly... you have no idea how to work it?! That might seem absolutely ridiculous however reality often is quite funny. A machine that you need might be exactly what you want but sometimes it's great to get yourself familiar with the technological advances! There is no instructor next to you though so you have to do on your own... or do you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/f3da1b05ba0ed92d68b5451ac01412083d861a60.png[/img]

Everytime you find yourself wondering how an exact feature of the game works you can simply press "H" button to access an encyclopedia! We've talked about that feature before but now we're making it even more approachable and easy to use. No more flipping through pages in search of the right corner of the book - instead just stand in front of the machine, "aim" at it and press the button! It's so easy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/a2dbf147cbe1dfa4ff155b1d73bddf7d8cdb02aa.png[/img]

This particular feature will work on variety elements of the game while still being accessible in the old way. As such everyone should be content - both people who like to methodically flip pages and learn more about the baking world and those who prefer to "go at it" immediately! We sincerely hope that you will have a lot of great time using of encyclopedia and its enhanced way of use. 

[i]Thank you for tuning in to our devlog - see you in the next one![/i]

Best regards,
Bakery Simulator Team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #95 “Moving Trays!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]Logistics of your baking operation are very important - we have not forgotten to add a little convenience to your work area. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/858cafb3aa7b7cf444b3155e96b8213139623573.png[/img]

It would be really painful to run through your Bakery several times with a simple singular tray, right? Even more so if you decided to create and bake not 5 but for example 50 of your favourite muffins or croissants! As that is the case, Bakery Simulator will feature more than just a singular tray - that way you can work on several projects at the same time and be sure that you will manage all your orders on time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/ef84119da4721ffb036059385ed1eba3515d0a49.png[/img]

We went a step further - what good is having several trays if you still have to move them manually one by one? Wouldn't it be better if you could use them all and transport them all at the same time? Definitely! That is why the Bakery will feature a special carts that you will freely use to move your trays from one side of bakery to another! Just look at how many trays it can store at the same time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/d5b7935ff3663accc53d31e937981dff03a193e8.gif[/img]

And now, for the most exciting thing - you can actually "drive" the cart yourself! Whenever you need it and wherever you want it to go - simply grab the cart and move it to desired place. Isn't that super convenient? Especially since your Bakery grows in size and navigating such cart becomes a true pleasure! 

[previewyoutube=2ZopQyeAW9A;full][/previewyoutube]

We definitely hope such features will make your life as a Baker even more fun! 

[i]Thank you for tuning in to our devlog - see you in the next one![/i]

Best regards,
Bakery Simulator Team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #94 “More space, more machines and more colours!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]If you ever wondered about the scale of the customization and changes you can make to your Bakery - make sure to check out the screenshots below! [/h2]

This time we wanted to showcase few things at the same time! 

First of all the size of the Bakery changes depending on the level of your establishment. What you're seeing on the screenshots is the bigger bakery that you will be able to unlock in the game simply by playing through it. If you reach a point in the game where you'd think to yourself "well, I need more space" then most likely unlocking it will become your main objective!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/1e8431536d3b7f43cb152a57a532437d22112a70.png[/img]

We're also preparing few customization options - we'll talk about it in greater details closer to the release date, however if you take a look at the screenshots and compare them with what you already know from the demo and other our screenshots you will quickly notice many changes throughout the whole Bakery. Walls, floor, tables and machines... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/41ead8e1b33f4e87814b6ce2514bfa7bb7a75f29.png[/img]

Yes, exactly, machines! There will be quite a few of them available for you to use and enhance your baking process! Hopefully that would translate into greater quality of your job and... more enjoyment! We hope they will help a lot during your baking quest and will make many of the customers happy! As in case with customization options, we'll talk more about machines closer to the release!

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #91 “What to do when the road is closed?!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]What?! Another blocked road? But I've got deliveries to finish![/h2]

It's almost never good to be late. Especially if we're talking about professional obligations. Everyone tends to get a little bit frustrated when deadlines are almost upon us. In our line of work that goes both for people in the Bakery, drivers and customers. But imagine what must a driver feel when he is already getting close to being late and then suddenly sees that the road he took is unpassable and he needs to find another one? Oh, the horror!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/a6089f1d83eabc5fe5e142ba4d2b7b276bad2d06.png[/img]

That's the life in the city though. Sometimes roads will get blocked and you need to be properly prepared for that possibility. Thankfully, we're not going to make it too difficult for you as we know that sudden changes to your carefully crafted plan might only irritate you. Instead, we'll give you an option to plan your delivery accordingly in order to avoid unnecessary stress and showcase your awesome planning/driving skills. Isn't that great? Before the delivery, you'll be able to check what roads are currently potential issue-makers and you will be able to plan your way around those points! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/e1e2b0b4c347816bab46a4a07112bd571a7f475c.jpg[/img]

The roadblocks itself might happen due to variety of reasons. Perhaps there was an accident and now you can't drive through as medical staff is tending to victims or maybe Police is trying to catch someone and they purposefully blocked some paths they believe to be escape roads. The accidents themselves might be different so you'll most likely see different situations while riding through the city. Of course there is also a chance that right now, in the crucial moment, a parade or protests are on-going... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/cde7416b1944b0d04687fee213adebd5dfe9ebae.png[/img]

Every day those blocked paths will change and every day you'll be able to check them before going out to deliver your goodies. Make sure to always check the map - it will save you a lot of problems! 

[i]See you again - in the next devlog![/i]

Best regards,

Bakery Simulator team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #87 “Spice and Bakery!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]Let's add some spice to our life![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/822d67de7cd5585baf096f2af35cde4d5f2e4f13.jpg[/img]

Well, look at that! That's a lot of spices! And what is even more fun - they're all at your disposal! During your daily baking endeavors, you'll be able to add certain spices to the mix that you yourself will have to choose and select. Adding that little bit of extra oomph to the recipe might just be an amazing way of ensuring that your creation tastes great and will be appropriately appreciated by your customers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/b476f20fba3a53625aa9dbe072d76e5acb07feda.jpg[/img]

Of course, you're also free to not use spices at all - it's an extra touch that might add something to your goods but if you select poorly you might ruin whatever you're trying to bake. For each of the recipes, there will be a spice that nicely complements the pastry but also one that will not work well together. As you continue playing the game and experiment with the spices you will slowly learn which one works great with particular products! Additionally - the in-game Bakerypedia will also have a subtle hint for you regarding the appropriate selection of the spices so you might want to spare a moment to read about the pastry you're currently trying to make. 

As soon as you find and use a good spice the information about it will be added to the Bakerypedia! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/464bdf6a158aba2b9c5962c0d7e652aab044e151.jpg[/img]

What is more, while you might not use the spices at all using the correct one will yield additional financial gain for your trouble! Consider it a nice gesture from your customers as they appreciate the extra step you took in order to satisfy them. 

While with spices we want to add an additional layer of gameplay to the game we also don't want to overcomplicate it - the spices will behave a little bit different compared to normal ingredients - for example, you will not have to worry about selecting the right amount of them - you can simply focus on selecting the right one! They will also be separated from other ingredients and will be placed in a different part of the Bakery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/68923009e4d1982ad9532c0530d0a6a002ee1dc5.jpg[/img]

Keep in mind that you will be able to use only one spice for a particular pastry - choose well... but if you make a mistake and want to correct yourself you can always do that by using the extractor tool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/2fac62f9871202d6354c67c1171b707f6a456655.png[/img]

We definitely understand how frustrating it is to forget about the right order of adding ingredients or exact proportions within which you should operate. Sometimes you lose concetration for a second and it's really hard to recall whether you've added 10g or 100g of sugar. It's especially problematic when you have a particularly strict recipe and you need to follow it completely to reach a certain result. No worries though! Our team was quick to realize that it might lead to some unsatisfying or straight-up irritating moments in the game and that is why we've prepared a solution for it. 
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/4208c27c2ea53e6370f4f7414d96ac9f8ba3ee7c.png[/img]
	
Take a look at the screenshots - as you can see every single ingredient that you've added to the bowl is displayed on the screen next to an appropriate bowl so you will not mistake it with any spare bowl you might have. Thanks to this solution it's easy to check what has already been done within your current baking process. Combining that with the note on the top right corner of the screen you can always easily check your progress.
		
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/4572d63019b3fb64aaa2ed32eae51d85a5454393.png[/img]

In other words - when you'll be playing the game and you'll have to suddenly pause it for any reason - it will still be very easy to come back to it and continue from the point you left it off. You will face many challenges when baking and managing your own Bakery but we'll be sure to prepare many tools to make the whole journey very satisfying. 

[i]Thank you for tuning in this time and see you next week![/i]
